{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

dup_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {dup_count}')
print(f'Unique patients: {len(df["patient_id"].unique())}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {sentinel_count}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
max_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Average max sample_seq per patient: {max_seq_per_patient.mean()}')"}
